description: This is a Python script implementing a command-line interface for building Zephyr applications using West. It defines a Build class with methods to parse arguments, set up build directories, run CMake, and execute builds, including support for pristine builds and test configurations.

classes.name: Build
classes.description: A class representing the 'build' command for Zephyr applications, handling argument parsing, build directory setup, CMake invocation, and build execution.

methods.name: do_add_parser
methods.description: Adds command-line arguments for the build command to the parser.

methods.name: do_run
methods.description: Executes the build process based on parsed arguments, including setup, CMake configuration, and build steps.

methods.name: _find_board
methods.description: Determines the target board for the build from cache, environment, or configuration.

methods.name: _parse_remainder
methods.description: Parses remaining command-line arguments for source directory and CMake options.

methods.name: _parse_test_item
methods.description: Parses test metadata from YAML files to configure build options.

methods.name: _sanity_precheck
methods.description: Checks existence of source directory and presence of CMakeLists.txt.

methods.name: _update_cache
methods.description: Loads the CMake cache from the build directory.

methods.name: _setup_build_dir
methods.description: Initializes the build directory, creating it if necessary.

methods.name: _find_source_dir
methods.description: Determines the source directory for the build.

methods.name: _sanity_check_source_dir
methods.description: Validates that source and build directories are correctly set and not conflicting.

methods.name: _sanity_check
methods.description: Performs overall sanity checks on build configuration and cache.

methods.name: _run_cmake
methods.description: Configures the build system using CMake with appropriate options.

methods.name: _run_pristine
methods.description: Resets the build directory to a pristine state.

methods.name: _run_build
methods.description: Executes the build or target specified.

methods.name: _append_verbose_args
methods.description: Adds verbose flags to CMake commands based on generator.
